name: Update Issue
description: Updates an existing project issue. [See the documentation](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/issues.html#edit-issue)

configurable_props.name: projectId
configurable_props.label: Project ID
configurable_props.description: The project ID, as displayed in the main project page

configurable_props.name: issueIid
configurable_props.label: Issue Internal ID
configurable_props.description: The internal ID of a project's issue

configurable_props.name: labels
configurable_props.label: Labels
configurable_props.description: Comma-separated label names for an issue. Set to an empty string to unassign all labels

configurable_props.name: assigneeIds
configurable_props.label: Assignee IDs
configurable_props.description: The ID of the user(s) to assign the issue to. Set to 0 or provide an empty value to unassign all assignees

configurable_props.name: stateEvent
configurable_props.label: State Event
configurable_props.description: The state event of an issue. Set close to close the issue and reopen to reopen it

configurable_props.name: discussionLocked
configurable_props.label: Lock Discussion
configurable_props.description: Flag indicating if the issue's discussion is locked. If the discussion is locked only project members can add or edit comments
